positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Web Developer Alvernia University Reading, PA (November 2017 – Present)
•	Managed and trained approximately 100 Drupal content editors in various departments.
•	Planned, developed, built and maintained the university’s web-based communications platform in support of the marketing & communications goals.
•	Ensured proper functionality and compliance for Section 508 accessibility standards.

positions.title: Email Analyst (Contract)
positions.description:
Used Silverpop (IBM Marketing Cloud) to generate and schedule responsive HTML emails for marketing and customer service mailings.

Used JIRA to ensure projects were on time and properly tested.

positions.title: Marketing Automation Developer (Contract)
positions.description:
Worked with Marketing content owners and designers to rebrand E-Book and Webinar Landing pages.

Used Marketo, jQuery, HTML and CSS to create templates for Marketing forms.

positions.title: Web Developer - Marketing
positions.description:
Responsible for managing, developing strategy, and front end coding for several corporate sites (www.tmlt.org, www.tmic.org, www.lonestara.com) 

Completed UX Bootcamp course at General Assembly  

SEO – Brought TMLT.ORG pages to the 4th position in Google results after one month. Created Google Analytics reports to track site progress. Click rate increased from 1.8% to 2.3% 

Created prototype of recommendations for improved mobile site: https://popapp.in/w/projects/57b61f7dff86fe4001dfb503/mockups

positions.title: Marketing Automation Production Manager (Contract)
positions.description:
Build HTML emails and email templates for a variety of marketing campaigns.

Create dynamic and responsive email and landing page layouts.

Ensure emails and landing pages are 100% accessible and optimized for various email clients on web and mobile platforms.

QA emails and program builds and troubleshoot and resolve issues as necessary.

Experience with testing and automation tools such as Litmus, Marketo, and SilverPop.

positions.title: Technician
positions.description:
Repaired and rebuilt equipment used in oilfield operations.
    
Served as consultant for all computer-related issues (troubleshooting, software updates).
    
Evaluated current policies and made recommendations for improvement.
    
Created a MySQL/ PHP web application for tracking and managing inventory/field activities.

positions.title: Web and Social Media Strategist
positions.description:
Created and maintained web marketing strategy for IBM's Business Process Management (BPM) portfolio. Over 10,000 visits per month
    http://www-03.ibm.com/software/products/en/category/BPM-SOFTWARE

Worked with a team located abroad that was tasked with creating monthly and ad hoc reports. 

Presented the findings to management in order make informed decisions on web direction.

Held regular meetings on the status of sites and worked with several internal teams to make necessary changes and launch new microsites.
    
Designed and Developed the content area for the marketing pages of BlueworksLive:
    https://www.blueworkslive.com/
    
Designed all pages for the Smarter Process initiative:
    http://www-01.ibm.com/software/solutions/process/
    
Used Typepad to create a blog for IBM's VP of BPM.
    http://lombardicto.typepad.com/
    
Experience with Hootsuite for Social Media monitoring and reporting.

positions.title: Webmaster
positions.description:
Worked with designers and LeadGen staff to maximize the effectiveness of the Lombardi corporate website.
    
In charge of all development (PHP, HTML, CSS, Javascript, Script.aculo.us, Dojo Toolkit) for lombardi.com.
    
Extensive experience with wireframes and converting mockups to HTML.
    
Created and maintained a partner portal for secure downloads.
    
Experience with development and management of a Wordpress blog.

positions.title: Web Producer
positions.description:
Used HTML, ColdFusion 7, Flash MX/Actionscript, XML, and Javascript to create innovative web applications and database-driven sites that supplemented printed materials.
    
Worked closely with several departments including sales to complete assigned projects.
    
Experience with Vignette CMS, ColdFusion Server Administration, SQL database design and integration.
    
Experience with Photoshop CS, Flash MX 2004, SoundForge, audio/video streaming with Real Producer, Windows Media, and Flash Communication Server.

positions.title: Programmer III
positions.description:
Worked with a team of designers and developers to create and maintain internal and external sites for the US Navy Training Division.
    ex: http://www.cnatra.navy.mil/matsg22/headquarters.aspx

Collaborated with Navy personnel to provide up to the minute information on designated sites regarding emergency management.
    
Hosted meetings with clients to discuss project details and offer solutions and/or enhancements to existing sites.
    
Experience with ColdFusion, SQL Server, Dreamweaver, Photoshop, Flash.
    
Training/Workshops: Borland Software Testing Workshop, Rational Unified Process.
